title: Concept: Interpreter floor with no upper bound
description: setup.cfg declares a `python_requires` of `>=X.Y` only, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `python_requires` of `>=X.Y` only.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through setup.cfg (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `python_requires` of `>=X.Y` only.
